command:paged.sample.hello: The editor never loads the sample bundle: main.tsx loads its bundles through plugin-sdk's loadBundle, and the shell's worker loader with sampleBundleManifest() has no caller, so no headless editor or browser session has the command. Its handler, its worker round trip and its key binding are asserted through the shell's loader in packages/shell/test/bundles/sample-bundle.test.ts. An integration test becomes possible once the app loads the sample (a dev-build flag); deleting the sample removes the entry.
command:paged.host.submit: Registered only when an embedding host supplies the action (hostCommands in apps/canvas/src/app/instance.tsx, used by mountEditor); the editor's own page mounts without host actions, so no headless editor or journey has the command yet. The command table and its handlers are asserted in apps/canvas/test/unit/app/host-commands.test.ts. The integration test arrives with the embedding example host (plan task E7), whose journey submits and closes through these commands.
